qc.name: Source lineage
qc.reason: Actual catalog acquisition IDs and unsigned source assets retained; cropped numeric and display SHA-256 hashes computed.

qc.name: Comparable orbit
qc.reason: Same platform, relative orbit 150, direction and VV/VH channels; aligned 30 m projected grid.

qc.name: Common valid support
qc.reason: Both VV and VH valid at both dates over 100.000% of ROI pixel centers.

qc.name: Threshold sensitivity
qc.reason: Screening repeated at -18, -17 and -16 dB; sensitivity is reported, not a calibrated classification accuracy.

qc.name: Geomorphic interpretation
qc.reason: Land-to-water and water-to-land classes are low-backscatter threshold transitions, not confirmed erosion/accretion. Stage, wind, incidence and mangrove tidal changes remain confounders.

jamuna.interpretation: Measured SAR backscatter and reproducible threshold-screening candidates; no damage, population-at-risk or permanent-erosion claim.
